summary: Block 16A is at UCSF's Mission Bay North Campus. UCSF's June 2025 presentation listed Blocks 16A and B as undeveloped research parcels with no building plans at Mission Bay; on May 6, 2026 the University of California approved a 153,600-gross-square-foot, five-level 'Mission Bay Block 16A Building' for ear and hearing care and research on Block 16A and part of 16B, which UCSF's release (the Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute, Fifth Street at Nelson Rising Lane) says will start construction in late 2026, complete in 2029 and open in 2030.

milestones.text: UCSF's Mission Bay CAC presentation lists 'Block 16A & B – Research' among undeveloped parcels remaining 'per UCSF's Long Range Development Plan' and states 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now' (about eleven months before the approval below)

The University of California approves the Mission Bay Block 16A Building (Notice of Determination: 153,600 gross sq ft, five above-ground levels with the fifth shelled, donor-developed, for clinical care and research on ear and hearing disorders; location Block 16A and a portion of Block 16B); UCSF's release says the Regents approved the Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute. The two are matched here on date, use and building form; no document read names both
Truebeck Construction announces it was selected as general contractor for the Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute, 150,000 sq ft at Fifth Street and Nelson Rising Lane
Construction expected to begin in 'late 2026' (UCSF release); The Registry says 'late-2026 groundbreaking'. No groundbreaking is recorded in any source read
Completion anticipated in 2029, occupancy in 2030 (UCSF release, as republished); the release's own caption says 'scheduled to open in 2030'

open_questions: UCSF's own news page for the Regents approval (ucsf.edu) could not be opened here (blocked); the release is cited through Mirage News' republication, which labels itself a public release from the originating organization.

No document read says in so many words that the 'Mission Bay Block 16A Building' in the Notice of Determination is the Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute; the match rests on the same approval date (May 6, 2026), ear-and-hearing use, five levels and donor funding.

Addendum #6 to the 2014 Long Range Development Plan EIR (April 2026, per the Notice of Determination) and the Regents item are on UCSF Real Estate's reports page, which could not be opened here; no cost was read.
Construction start is a forecast ('late 2026'); no groundbreaking or building permit was found as of 2026-10-10. The 2029 completion and 2030 occupancy are UCSF's own forecasts.
The map's 16A/16B split is a bisection, while the project takes all of 16A plus 'a portion of Block 16B' (Notice of Determination); the footprint's exact extent on 16B is not stated.
Whether any other use is planned for the rest of Block 16A: none stated. The OCII land use map shows 16A as a UCSF parcel (colour fill is graphic, not read as text).
